`baseline_RMSE` = always predicting the average load. `interval_margin` = ± width of the 90% prediction range; `interval_coverage_test` = share of test buildings whose true value fell inside.

## 3. Demand classification (Low / Medium / High)

| model                |   cv_F1_mean |   val_accuracy |   val_F1_macro |
|:---------------------|-------------:|---------------:|---------------:|
| Logistic Regression  |       0.7875 |         0.7586 |         0.761  |
| K-Nearest Neighbours |       0.8491 |         0.8534 |         0.8565 |
| Decision Tree        |       0.9256 |         0.9397 |         0.9423 |
| Random Forest        |       0.9237 |         0.931  |         0.9324 |
| Gradient Boosting    |       0.9368 |         0.9483 |         0.9497 |

- Thresholds on total load (from training data): 31.53 and 58.79 kWh/m²
- Best classifier: **Gradient Boosting** -> test accuracy 0.9483, macro-F1 0.9481
- Regress-then-classify (predict loads, then apply thresholds) -> test accuracy 0.9569, macro-F1 0.9558
